'''Chopsticks''', also called '''grub-sticks''',<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> were a pair of thin sticks<ref name="SW89">[[Star Wars (1977) 89|''Star Wars'' (1977) 89]]</ref> used as eating utensils by the [[Asogian/Legends|Asogians]].<ref name="swcw" /><ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52361960|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" and "Lone Wolf"|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2015-05-04|time=4:30 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180314000518/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/abel-g-pe%C3%B1as-skyewalkers-and-lone-wolf.50027998/page-7}}</ref> They were notably favored by [[Braxas]], an Asogian resident on [[Solay]]. On one occasion, Braxas forced [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to use chopsticks to grasp his [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] while a [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Scorpion/Legends|scorpion]] tried to attack his hand.<ref name="SW89" /><ref name="JCF" />
